an3.76:1.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami. Upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:
an3.76:1.3: Kittāvatā nu kho bhante bhavo hotī ti?
an3.76:2.1: Kāmadhātuvepakkañ ca Ānanda kammaṃ nābhavissa api nu kho kāmabhavo paññāyethā ti?
an3.76:2.3: Iti kho Ānanda kammaṃ khettaṃ viññāṇaṃ bījaṃ taṇhā sineho
an3.76:2.4: avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ hīnāya dhātuyā viññāṇaṃ patiṭṭhitaṃ. Evaṃ āyatiṃ punabbhavābhinibbatti hoti.
an3.76:3.1: Evaṃ kho Ānanda bhavo hotī ti. 2. Rūpadhātuvepakkañ ca Ānanda kammaṃ nābhavissa api nu kho rūpabhavo paññāyethā ti?
an3.76:3.3: Iti kho Ānanda kammaṃ khettaṃ viññāṇaṃ bījaṃ taṇhā sineho
an3.76:3.4: avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ majjhimāya dhātuyā viññāṇaṃ patiṭṭhitaṃ. Evaṃ āyatiṃ punabbhavābhinibbatti hoti. 3.
an3.76:4.1: Arūpadhātuvepakkañ ca Ānanda kammaṃ nābhavissa api nu kho arūpabhavo paññāyethā ti?
an3.76:4.3: Iti kho Ānanda kammaṃ khettaṃ viññāṇaṃ bījaṃ taṇhā sineho
an3.76:4.4: avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ paṇītāya dhātuyā viññāṇaṃ patiṭṭhitaṃ. Evaṃ āyatiṃ punabbhavābhinibbatti hoti.
